title: Orgs Configuration
description: Array of organization definitions. Each org groups products and optionally defines org-level dashboards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the org (kebab-case slug).

products.description: List of product IDs that belong to this org.

dashboards.description: Org-level dashboards (aggregated across all child products/teams).

orgConfig.description: Org-level configuration. Currently unused but reserved for future settings.

id.description: Dashboard identifier, unique within the parent entity.

type.description: Dashboard type key (e.g. baseorgmetrics, prcycletime, issuecycletime).

title.description: Display title shown in the dashboard tab.

description.description: HTML-safe description shown below the dashboard title.

chaturl.description: URL of the AI chat assistant endpoint.

aianalyticsurl.description: URL of the endpoint that returns AI analytics tooltips.

diagrams.description: Ordered list of diagram widgets to render.

endpoint.description: URL of the endpoint that returns the diagram data.

span.description: Grid column span (1 = half width, 2 = full width).

title.description: Optional override title for this diagram widget.

aianalytics.description: Whether to fetch and show AI analytics tooltip for this diagram.

description.description: Optional description for this diagram widget (shown as tooltip or subtitle).

params.description: Extra workflow request parameters for this diagram (e.g. {"view": "criteria"}). Merged into the request body; standard parameters are never overridden.
